# Resolve unlisted learn/agentos/ Markdown files via tree registration or parent guide links

## Context

Sub-issue of `#20498` implementing **Row 12 (`unlisted-files`)** of the three-reader `learn/` map ([`#20498#issuecomment-6697670393`](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/20498#issuecomment-6697670393)).

- **Ownership disposition:** `unowned-rationale: claimable leaf under #20498 per map #issuecomment-6697670393 (delegated filing by @neo-fable-mnemosyne)`

## The Problem

A census of `learn/**/*.md` against `learn/tree.json` (`#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` Row 12) identified 9 Markdown files outside `learn/tree.json`:
1. `learn/agentos/decisions/0004-session-id-provenance-contract.md` (covered by Row 3 `#20526`)
2. `learn/agentos/decisions/0007-agents-md-compaction-taxonomy.md` (covered by Row 3 `#20526`)
3. `learn/agentos/tooling/GenesisNeuralLinkProbe.md`
4. `learn/agentos/tooling/ChromeDevToolsMcpServer.md`
5. `learn/agentos/process/SeatEvidenceCapabilities.md`
6. `learn/agentos/AGENTS_ATLAS.md`
7. `learn/agentos/measurements/2026-06-30-claude-code-2-1-89-prompt-cache-regression.md`
8. `learn/agentos/measurements/2026-07-04-opus-4-6-effort-spike-and-tier-routing.md`
9. `learn/README.md`

Without an explicit disposition for each unlisted file, reader-facing tooling guides (`GenesisNeuralLinkProbe.md`, `ChromeDevToolsMcpServer.md`, `SeatEvidenceCapabilities.md`) remain invisible in the Portal navigation and unlinked from parent guides.

Design authority: `#20498` + `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` (Row 12 `unlisted-files`) + `.agents/skills/guide-authoring/references/guide-authoring-bar.md` §0 & §4.

## The Architectural Reality

- Per `guide-authoring-bar.md` §0 and §4:
  - Storytelling guides belong in `learn/tree.json`.
  - Deep reference/tooling/measurement specs (`ChromeDevToolsMcpServer.md`, `GenesisNeuralLinkProbe.md`, `SeatEvidenceCapabilities.md`, `measurements/*.md`) should either be listed on a reference shelf in `learn/tree.json` or explicitly linked from their parent guide (`NeuralLink.md`, `CoreSkills.md`, `AGENTS_ATLAS.md`) so neither human readers nor the Knowledge Base lose them.
  - `learn/README.md` (the GitHub directory front door) and `learn/agentos/AGENTS_ATLAS.md` (the agent-instruction World Atlas) are intentionally unlisted in the Portal tree (`UsingTheseTopics.md` is the Portal tree's door).

## The Fix

1. Apply an explicit per-file disposition for the remaining unlisted files outside Row 3 (`#20526`):
   - Link or register `learn/agentos/tooling/GenesisNeuralLinkProbe.md` and `learn/agentos/tooling/ChromeDevToolsMcpServer.md` from `learn/agentos/NeuralLink.md` (and/or the `agentos` reference shelf in `learn/tree.json` alongside Row 13).
   - Link `learn/agentos/process/SeatEvidenceCapabilities.md` and `learn/agentos/measurements/*.md` from `learn/agentos/CoreSkills.md` / `learn/agentos/AGENTS_ATLAS.md`.
   - Record the intentional non-tree status of `learn/README.md` and `learn/agentos/AGENTS_ATLAS.md`.

## Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Source of authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback / edge case | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Unlisted `learn/agentos/{tooling,process,measurements}/*.md` + `learn/tree.json` | `#20498#issuecomment-6697670393` Row 12 + `guide-authoring-bar.md` §0 & §4 | Every Markdown file under `learn/` is either listed in `learn/tree.json` or explicitly linked from a tree-registered parent guide (with `learn/README.md` and `AGENTS_ATLAS.md` documented as intentional non-tree roots) | Coordinate `0004` and `0007` with `#20526` (Row 3) | `learn/agentos/*.md`, `learn/tree.json` | `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` |

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] **AC-1:** Every file in the Row 12 census (`GenesisNeuralLinkProbe.md`, `ChromeDevToolsMcpServer.md`, `SeatEvidenceCapabilities.md`, `measurements/*.md`, `AGENTS_ATLAS.md`, `learn/README.md`, plus `0004`/`0007` via `#20526`) has an explicit, implemented disposition (registered in `learn/tree.json` or linked from a tree-registered parent guide).
- [ ] **AC-2:** `node ./buildScripts/util/check-relative-links.mjs` and `node ./buildScripts/util/check-whitespace.mjs` pass with `0` errors.

## Out of Scope

Hand-editing `apps/portal/sitemap.xml` or `apps/portal/llms.txt`.

## Avoided Traps

- Leaving orphan Markdown files in `learn/agentos/` with zero inbound links from tree-registered pages.
